name: Plasma Orb · Death
primary:
A slow orb flies where you look and explodes in a 3.5-block radius on contact, after 4 s of flight, or when chain lightning passes nearby. Effects:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ lightning + 1.25 ❤ arcane (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4 s
• Life drain: 0.5 ❤ damage, you heal 0.2 ❤
